task: Core 1186 U08: deny strict Pro Digital Office capabilities without canonical webshop instance; preserve Alap commerce plan fallback

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Authorization-critical missing tenant context is a trusted-boundary fault. The precise central strict-Pro feature taxonomy already exists and must be reused, not duplicated. Deny before fallback to profile/default; preserve explicit current-instance entitlement authority and all other feature behavior.

acceptanceCriteria: hasCurrentPlanFeature(teamChat) returns false if getCurrentWebshopInstance() returns null, independent of Pro fallback via WEBSHOP_DEFAULT_PLAN or profiles.subscription_plan.
hasCurrentPlanFeature(officeCommunicationAdvanced) returns false without a current instance, independent of profile/default plan.
Strict Pro Office feature list comes only from existing src/lib/plans/catalog.ts isStrictProOfficeFeature, not a second plan controller.
If an instance exists, hasCurrentPlanFeature continues to require getFeatureEntitlementDecision(instance.id,feature).enabled===true.
If no instance and feature is not strict Pro Office, fallback behavior remains the previous hasPlanFeature(await getCurrentPlan(),feature).
Alap support, basic officeCommunication transactional email, standard customer notifications and Pro permitted feature handling are unchanged.

Pro boundary negative and positive tests plus Critical Plan Before Code, Knowledge/Atlas, Edit-Time/Reference/Implementation Sync, Incremental Replay, Release Risk, exact-head CI/Truth/Lifecycle PASS.
invariants: Tenant-scoped Pro-only capabilities require an actual canonical current webshop instance and explicit current instance entitlement.
No fallback profile/default plan can stand in for tenant subscription and entitlement for internal office operations.
Preserve normal Alap transactional email and other non-Office fallback semantics.
Never grant a strict Pro Office feature when no canonical tenant is resolved; deny as early as possible.
forbiddenStates: A profile with subscription_plan pro but no valid current webshop resolves hasCurrentPlanFeature(teamChat) or hasCurrentPlanFeature(officeCommunicationAdvanced) true.
WEBSHOP_DEFAULT_PLAN=pro without current webshop authorizes private Office/Team Chat.
Change hasPlanFeature fallback for non-strict-Office capabilities.
Introduce a new hard-coded teamChat/officeCommunicationAdvanced list independent of the canonical catalog.
Mark #1186 DONE while RLS, downgrade/expiry and real tenant-acceptance closure are unverified.

semanticExecutionRoute.request: Core 1186 U08: deny strict Pro Digital Office capabilities without canonical webshop instance; preserve Alap commerce plan fallback

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Current hasCurrentPlanFeature() falls back to profiles.subscription_plan or WEBSHOP_DEFAULT_PLAN whenever getCurrentWebshopInstance() cannot resolve the canonical webshop. A profile or environment set to Pro can thereby advertise access to strict Pro-only Digital Office features despite no tenant-scoped subscription or entitlement. This violates fail-closed tenant authority for internal Office permissions.
observableOutcomes: No tenant instance means teamChat and officeCommunicationAdvanced always return false, even when profile or environment fallback is Pro.
When tenant instance exists, the existing explicit entitlement resolver and actual instance subscription remain authoritative, unchanged.
Normal released capabilities may retain their original documented no-instance profile/default behavior; no other package entitlement or transaction email changes.
Tests include anti-bypass, positive instance-delegation, and Alap baseline preservation.
unresolvedRisks: The no-tenant fallback is shared with standalone demo/legacy features; only strict Pro Office codes are excluded and no broad fallback deletion is allowed.
Malformed instance resolution or stale session may be hidden by profile pro fallback; this change must prevent office only and not mask the missing store context.
Backend RLS, subscription transitions, UI entitlement snapshots and other direct paths remain separate bounded closure units; #1186 must stay OPEN/PARTIAL.

in: hasCurrentPlanFeature no-instance strict Pro Office denial using existing isStrictProOfficeFeature canonical catalog
Targeted regression tests for profile/default-plan no-tenant bypass and preserved Alap/email baseline
out: Change central plan catalog grants, SQL migrations, tenant plan-sync or Pro entitlements
Change non-Office fallback behavior, Team Chat separate RBAC gates, worker, API or storage
Claim RLS/down-grade/full Digital Office package closure, close parent issue #1186
